# pidginhost_ssh_key (Resource)

An SSH public key stored in the account (`/api/account/ssh-keys/`). Reference it from a server with `ssh_key_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_ssh_key" "deploy" {
  alias      = "deploy"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `public_key` (String) The public key in OpenSSH format. Changing it replaces the resource, because the API cannot update a stored key. Surrounding whitespace is ignored when comparing with the API.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Name of the key, up to 50 characters. Can be changed in place.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the key, as computed by the API.
- `id` (String) SSH key ID.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>

Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an SSH key by its ID.
terraform import pidginhost_ssh_key.deploy 123
```
